nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Collector for course_id=6 (course_code and course_name as listed). A strictly read-only Canvas collector: call canvas_list_student_submissions(course_id=6, per_page=100, page=1), then keep calling page=2,3,... while pagination.has_more is true. The tool result may be truncated in the chat preview — always read the FULL JSON from the output_path file given in the result. A submission counts as graded iff it has a non-null numeric score field and workflow_state == "graded". Scores are on a 0-100 percentage scale. Aggregate all graded submissions in one script execution and return ONLY the compact JSON {course_id:6, course_code, course_name, avg_score, median_score, pass_rate, total_students, graded_count, pages}, where avg_score/median_score are the mean/median of graded scores, pass_rate = 100 * count(score >= 60) / graded_count, and total_students = number of DISTINCT user_ids among graded submissions. Do not return the row set, write any workspace file, or modify Canvas.
